onboarding.welcomeDescription: Let us give you a quick tour of the main features. It only takes a minute.

welcome.title: Welcome, Administrator!
welcome.description: As an admin, you have full control over the application. Let's walk through the key areas.

orchestras.title: Orchestras
orchestras.description: Start by setting up your orchestras. Each orchestra can have its own members, repertoire, and rehearsal schedule.

members.title: Member Management
members.description: Add members to the system. You can create accounts manually, invite via email, or sync with Microsoft Entra ID.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Configure your organization: branding, integrations (Spond, Microsoft SSO), email settings, and more.

rehearsals.title: Rehearsals
rehearsals.description: Set up default rehearsal days for each orchestra. Individual rehearsals will be generated automatically.

done.title: You're all set!
done.description: You now know the basics. Explore the other sections when you're ready. The User Guide has more detailed information.

welcome.title: Welcome, Music Committee!
welcome.description: As part of the music committee, you manage the sheet music library. Let's see what you can do.

upload.title: Upload Music
upload.description: Upload PDF sheet music here. Files are parsed automatically if you use the naming convention: Title_Arranger_Instrument_Key.pdf

lists.title: Music Lists
lists.description: Create concert programs and repertoire lists. Add pieces, reorder them, and calculate total duration.

pieces.title: Music Pieces
pieces.description: Browse all uploaded sheet music. Filter by instrument, orchestra, or search by title.

titles.title: Titles
titles.description: Manage the title database with composer, arranger, genre, and duration information. Link to MusicaInfo.net for automatic metadata.

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.description: Configure instruments and their aliases. This helps with automatic matching when uploading music.

done.title: Ready to go!
done.description: You're set up to manage the music library. Check the User Guide for detailed instructions.

welcome.title: Welcome, Conductor!
welcome.description: As a conductor, you can manage rehearsals and view the repertoire. Let's take a quick look.

rehearsals.title: Rehearsals
rehearsals.description: View and manage the rehearsal schedule. You can add extra rehearsals, cancel sessions, and see attendance.

pieces.title: Browse Music
pieces.description: View all available sheet music for your orchestras. Preview PDFs and listen to recordings.

mymusic.title: My Music
mymusic.description: Your personal music page shows pieces assigned to your instrument(s). Download them for practice.

done.title: All done!
done.description: You're ready to start. The User Guide has more information if you need it.

welcome.title: Welcome!
welcome.description: This app helps you access your sheet music and stay updated on rehearsals. Let's show you around.

userGuide.subtitle: Learn how to use the music management application
userGuide.noResults: No sections found for your search.

gettingStarted.title: Getting Started
gettingStarted.content:
Welcome to the music management application! This guide will help you get started.

First steps

  • Dashboard — Your personal overview with upcoming rehearsals and recent music
  • My Music — View and download your assigned sheet music
  • Rehearsals — See the rehearsal schedule and register attendance

Use the sidebar navigation to explore different features. On mobile, tap the menu icon at the bottom.

myMusic.title: My Music
myMusic.content:
The My Music page shows all sheet music assigned to your instrument(s).

Features

  • Filter — Filter by orchestra or search by title
  • Download — Click the download button to save PDFs
  • Preview — Click a piece to preview it in the browser
  • Audio — Some pieces include MP3 recordings you can listen to

Sheet music is automatically assigned based on your instrument profile. Contact the music committee if something is missing.

downloadMusic.title: Downloading Music
downloadMusic.content:
You can download sheet music in several ways:

Individual download

Click the download icon next to any piece to save the PDF.

Bulk download

Select multiple pieces using the checkboxes, then use the "Download selected" button.

Offline access

Downloaded PDFs are also cached for offline use. Visit the My Music page while online to pre-load your music.

reportIssues.title: Reporting Issues
reportIssues.content:
Found an error in your sheet music? Missing pages or wrong notes?

How to report

  1. Go to Issue Center in the Members section
  2. Click New Issue
  3. Select the affected piece and describe the problem
  4. The music committee will review and fix it

You can track the status of your reports in the Issue Center.

rehearsals.title: Rehearsals
rehearsals.content:
The Rehearsals page shows the rehearsal schedule for all your orchestras.

Features

  • Calendar view — See upcoming and past rehearsals
  • Details — Click a rehearsal for time, location, and notes
  • Attendance — If connected to Spond, attendance is synced automatically

Regular rehearsals are generated automatically. Extra rehearsals and cancellations are clearly marked.

tools.title: Music Tools
tools.content:
The Tools page provides helpful utilities for musicians:

Available tools

  • Metronome — Practice with adjustable tempo and time signature
  • Tuner — Tune your instrument using your device's microphone

These tools work offline and are designed to help you practice effectively.

profile.title: Profile Settings
profile.content:
Manage your account in Profile:

What you can change

  • Personal info — Update your name and email
  • Password — Change your password
  • Two-factor auth — Enable MFA for extra security
  • Language — Switch between Dutch, English, and German
  • Theme — Choose light, dark, or system theme
  • Notifications — Configure how you want to be notified

uploadMusic.title: Uploading Music
uploadMusic.content:
As a music committee member, you can upload new sheet music.

How to upload

  1. Go to Upload in the Library section
  2. Drag and drop PDF files, or click to browse
  3. Files are automatically parsed: Title_Arranger_Instrument_Key_Group_Clef.pdf
  4. Review and adjust metadata before confirming

Cloud import

You can also import directly from OneDrive or Google Drive without downloading first.

Tips

  • Use consistent naming for automatic parsing
  • Link pieces to existing titles for better organization
  • Add MP3 recordings for practice reference

manageLists.title: Managing Music Lists
manageLists.content:
Create and manage concert programs and setlists.

Creating a list

  1. Go to Lists in the Library section
  2. Click New List
  3. Add a name, orchestra, date, and optional description
  4. Add pieces by searching the library

Features

  • Drag and drop — Reorder pieces easily
  • Time calculation — Total duration is calculated automatically
  • Committee notes — Add internal notes (only visible to committee)
  • Export — Generate PDF programs for print

manageMembers.title: Managing Members
manageMembers.content:
As an administrator, you can manage all member accounts.

Member management

  • Add members — Create new accounts manually or invite via email
  • Edit profiles — Update info, instruments, and orchestra assignments
  • Assign roles — Set permissions (member, conductor, music committee, admin)
  • Deactivate — Disable accounts without deleting data

Entra ID sync

If connected to Microsoft Entra ID, members can be synced automatically from your organization directory.

Bulk import

Import multiple members at once using CSV upload.
